title: Extended Central Factorial Numbers and the Flickering Operator
summary: This paper introduces a class of extended central factorial numbers generated by a parity-dependent recurrence relation, termed the "flickering operator". We demonstrate that the resulting triangular structure, now indexed as OEIS A395021, provides a unified recursive framework for alternating bit sequences (A000975) and normalized tangent-secant coefficients (A036969). This study provides an alternative integer-based expansion for power sums.
